label: post-cleanup-evidence-binding
command:
import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from nisayon.engine.io import file_digest
root=Path.cwd().resolve()
location=json.loads((root/"docs/experiments/results/retained-declarations-002/retained-location.json").read_text())
packet=Path(location["root"])
for name, expected in location["files"].items():
    path=packet/name
    assert path.stat().st_size==expected["bytes"] and file_digest(path)==expected["sha256"], name
source=root/"artifacts/robolab-reproduced-source-001"
manifest=json.loads((source/"manifest.json").read_text())
for item in manifest["records"]:
    path=source/item["path"]
    assert path.stat().st_size==item["bytes"] and file_digest(path)==item["sha256"], item["path"]
summary=json.loads((root/"docs/experiments/results/robolab-record-001/summary-distinct-frames.json").read_text())
assert file_digest(root/"artifacts/robolab-import-006/external-record.json")==summary["full_import"]["sha256"]
costs=json.loads((root/"docs/experiments/results/engine-continuation-checks-001/cost-summary.json").read_text())
for item in costs["command_records"]:
    path=root/"docs/experiments/results/engine-continuation-checks-001"/item["id"]/"run.json"
    assert file_digest(path)==item["record_sha256"]
    record=json.loads(path.read_text())
    for name, expected in record["logs"].items():
        log=path.parent/name
        assert log.stat().st_size==expected["bytes"] and file_digest(log)==expected["sha256"]
paths=["src","tests","scripts","pyproject.toml","uv.lock"]
subprocess.run(["git","diff","--exit-code","54660e58078039b569d22031bbf3094ed2d80f91","--",*paths],check=True)
protected=["src/nisayon/evaluation","tests/evaluation","docs/evaluation","work/lanes/fable5.md","reproduction/sources","docs/experiments/results/development-ablation-001","docs/experiments/results/bounded-agent-comparison-001"]
subprocess.run(["git","diff","--exit-code","21ed4f6a8d8c1f1acbef1036d8f7d31f83e29755","--",*protected],check=True)
print(json.dumps({"native_files_unchanged_after_cleanup":len(location["files"]),"pinned_source_files_unchanged":len(manifest["records"]),"command_records_and_logs_verified":len(costs["command_records"]),"current_full_import_sha256":summary["full_import"]["sha256"],"source_tree_matches_tested_commit":"54660e58078039b569d22031bbf3094ed2d80f91","historical_and_evaluation_paths":"unchanged from startup","scope":"Local integrity after own-test temporary cleanup; no physical truth or custody claim"},indent=2))
